title: Aromatic Vietnamese Chwinamul Pho
description: Savor the flavors of Vietnam with this aromatic and savory Pho dish featuring the unique chwinamul vegetable, a low-glycemic-friendly twist on the classic recipe.

ingredients.name: Chwinamul Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Trimmed and sliced into thin strips

ingredients.name: Tempering Chocolate
ingredients.notes: Cocoa nibs or shaved dark chocolate

instructions: Combine beef broth, sliced ginger, cinnamon sticks, and star anise in a large stockpot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Add the sliced chwinamul, Thai basil, and bean sprouts to the broth.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are slightly tender.
Add the sliced beef to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Stir in the tempering chocolate, fish sauce, and soy sauce.
Serve the Pho hot, garnished with additional Thai basil and bean sprouts if desired.
